text:
Raj (oncall): heads-up, we're getting a bunch of startup failures in the ingestion and auth workers. KMS signing errors across multiple clusters. seeing it at ~02:13 UTC. paging SRE. :rotating_light:

incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered for schedule 'sre-primary' (high). incident id: INC-20270412-0917

Nora SRE: I'm on. Raj, paste the failure lines?

Raj (oncall): main failure: "signer: failed to fetch public key: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded". Also some 502s from the sidecar when verifying signed webhooks. Snippet:

```
2027-04-12T02:13:21Z worker-ingest[auth]: ERROR signer.go:98: KMS GetPublicKey rpc deadline exceeded
2027-04-12T02:13:21Z worker-auth[webhook]: WARN verifier.go:45: signature verification failed: could not retrieve key
```

Devon - runtime: Which KMS endpoint? We're using AWS KMS for hosted, GCP KMS for EU clusters. Any provider notices?

telemetry-bot: Alert: KMS API 5xx rate spiked to 15% in us-east-1 and 9% in europe-west1 in the last 5m.

Raj (oncall): I checked provider status pages: AWS not reporting a major outage but has "increased API error rates" note. GCP shows intermittent errors in europe-west1. Also seeing a correlated spike in retries from our KMS clients.

Lena Support: Customer impact - several customers reported failed onboarding and webhooks failing with 401. Support tickets #7082, #7087. Queue is growing.

Nora SRE: Immediate mitigations to consider: 1) enable local signer fallback using cached keys for inbound verification and token signing; 2) stop autoscaling group updates and any restart storms; 3) reduce client concurrency to KMS, enable circuit breaker; 4) route some signing traffic to a secondary region KMS if key material allowed.

Devon - runtime: We have a short-lived local cache for public keys used to verify webhooks but it's TTL=30s. I can bump TTL and add a "startup grace" flag so workers will accept cached key if KMS unreachable for X ms. Preparing patch.

Raj (oncall): @deploy-bot hold all runtime rollouts and scale-ups until further notice.

deploy-bot: Holds applied to runtime rolling deployments and ASG scale events.

telemetry-bot: Noting: increased queue length for ingestion pipelines (backpressure), 4 consumer groups showing >3min lag.

Devon - runtime: Pushing a hotfix to staging: local cache TTL -> 10m, STARTUP_ACCEPT_CACHED=true, KMS_CLIENT_TIMEOUT=300ms. Will test validate webhook flows in staging. PR: https://git.redwood.dev/runtime/merge/ef34b2

Nora SRE: While Devon tests, I'll throttle KMS client concurrency at the SDK layer and add jitter to retries to reduce burst pressure. Also enabling an emergency circuit-breaker policy to fail fast after 2 slow RPCs.

(02:30) Devon - runtime: Staging looks good: cached keys used, no external KMS calls on warm restarts, verification passing. Rolling to prod at 02:36 to 5% nodes.

(02:36) Nora SRE: 5% rollout OK, KMS calls from signing path dropped ~65% per telemetry. Queue lag decreased slightly.

Lena Support: Sent update to affected customers: "We're experiencing degraded authentication due to third-party KMS API errors. We've implemented a temporary fallback and are monitoring. Next update in 30 minutes."

(02:45) Devon - runtime: Increasing rollout to 25%. Still no regressions. No new customer tickets in the last 15m.

(02:58) Nora SRE: 25->100% completed at 03:02 UTC. Telemetry: signing errors down to baseline.

incident-bot: External provider updates: AWS advisory notices "increased API errors mitigated" for affected regions at 02:56 UTC. GCP reports "service restored" for europe-west1 at 03:05 UTC.

Raj (oncall): Confirming: ingestion and auth workers stable, startup failures not reproducible for 25m. We'll keep elevated monitoring for 90 minutes.

Devon - runtime: Post-incident action items I'm adding:
- P0: Implement robust startup signer that prefers cached key and allows configurable grace period when KMS unreachable.
- P1: Backoff and jitter improvements in KMS client; rate-limiter per region to avoid thundering herd.
- P1: Add metrics differentiating KMS error codes (Unavailable vs Throttling vs AccessDenied).
- P2: Runbook automation: auto-pause rollouts when KMS error rate >1% sustained for 3m.
- P2: Evaluate BYOK & dedicated HSM options for critical customers.

Nora SRE: Additional ops items:
- P0: Adjust alerting to page only on sustained KMS 5xx >1% for 5m to reduce noise, but keep high-severity pages on startup failure exceptions.
- P1: KB for support with templated customer messages.

Lena Support: I'll coordinate customer comms and reopen any tickets that reappear. Preparing a post-incident email draft.

Raj (oncall): Handoff in 25 minutes to Nora. I'll write timeline and own the initial postmortem doc.

(03:35) incident-bot: Incident INC-20270412-0917 status: resolved -> monitoring. Duration: 1h22m.

Nora SRE: Verified stability after 40m of monitoring. Marking incident as resolved and moving to postmortem. I'll pick up the remaining action items. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
